name: otto-mcp
description: OTTO Market (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every

platform_mcp_otto_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OTTO_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_otto_client_id.description: Client ID of a self-app created in OTTO Partner Connect > API access with the Products, Availability, Orders and Shipments interfaces enabled (https://api.otto.market/docs/sellers-integration).

platform_mcp_otto_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OTTO_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_otto_client_secret.description: The app's client secret (shown once in Partner Connect). Tokens are minted with the client credentials and the scopes 'products availability orders shipments'.

platform_mcp_otto_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OTTO_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_otto_currency.description: Price currency for update_listing, EUR for otto.de.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe mints a token and reads one SKU quantity ({resources: {variations[]}}) to verify the credentials and scopes.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Products-V5 updateProductVariationPrices POST /v5/products/prices [{sku, standardPrice: {amount, currency}}] sets the LIVE standard price of your SKU (listing_id = SKU; currency from the config field, EUR). Only the price is applied (`price` required); stock is set_inventory and product content goes through POST /v5/products. Asynchronous: status pending|done, raw.links point at the process.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Availability-V1 POST /v1/availability/quantities [{sku, quantity}] sets the available quantity of one SKU (`sku` required; any integer >= 0). Answers 207 with per-SKU results/errors in raw.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Products-V5 updateActiveStatus {status: [{sku, active: false}]} takes the SKU offline on otto.de (reversible with active: true). Asynchronous process (state pending|done).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders-V4 GET /v4/orders?fulfillmentStatus(ANNOUNCED|PROCESSABLE|SENT|RETURNED|CANCELLED_BY_PARTNER|CANCELLED_BY_MARKETPLACE)&fromOrderDate(ISO-8601)&limit(max 256), oldest first. Status is per position item (the first item's is shown); raw.salesOrderId and positionItems[].positionItemId are needed for shipping and cancellations. Paging is by cursor (raw.links next), so only the first page is returned.
